Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “mostly produced” to mean the dominant species by domestic felling volume in colonial Burma and switched the answer to Gurjan (Dipterocarpus). The riddle instead points to Burma/Myanmar under British rule producing the majority of the world’s teak—about 75%—so the correct answer is teak (75% of the world’s teak).
